battle.name: 亞歷山大大帝戰爭
battle.theater: 小亞細亞至印度河流域
battle.brief: 公元前三三四年春，馬其頓王亞歷山大渡赫勒斯滂，開啟對波斯人的十年戰爭：前三三三年五月在革拉尼庫斯河擊破波斯聯軍，十月於伊索斯再勝達里烏斯三世，前三三一年高加米拉奠定勝局，戰線直抵印度河。卡面的亞述長矛早本役五百六十餘年，其套筒鐵矛頭正是馬其頓薩里沙長矛的祖型。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 亞歷山大大帝戰爭是公元前三三四年至前三二三年馬其頓王國與阿契美尼德波斯帝國之間的十年大戰，交戰地域自赫勒斯滂海峽一路延伸到印度河上游。馬其頓一方是腓力二世改革後的國家機器：國王亞歷山大三世以伴騎、持薩里沙的方陣步兵、弓箭手與輕裝投射兵為骨架，輔以帖薩利亞騎兵、伊庇里亞的標槍手、克里特弓手與色雷斯輕盾兵，另有一支由雅典工程師埃庇馬庫斯等人率領的攻城工匠隊；全國男丁的徵發由各行省、盟邦與城市按人口比例分攤，名義上這支部隊以希臘同盟盟主的名義調度，但指揮權與補給全握在國王手中。波斯一方是阿契美尼德王朝的中央軍與各總督區的部隊：國王達里烏斯三世自帶王室御林、號稱長生軍的一萬精銳、持柳條大盾的盾兵、象隊與數百輛戰車抵禦陣線，各地總督如法爾那巴祖斯之子阿爾塔巴祖斯、阿爾薩提斯、斯皮塔刻斯各率本區部隊參戰，希臘僱傭兵約三萬人由門農統率，作為帝國最能打的一支外籍部隊。波斯仍有縱橫全境的御道驛站、龐大稅收，以及由腓尼基、塞浦路斯、埃及與希臘船隻組成的海軍，但海軍分屬數名提督，戰略協調困難。戰役東段另有印度諸王與北印度部族站在波斯一邊，而東歐的色雷斯、馬其頓人與希臘城邦的傭兵兵源，則在最後數年屢次倒向亞歷山大。
countriesEn: The Wars of Alexander the Great were a decade-long conflict between the kingdom of Macedon and the Achaemenid Persian empire, fought between 334 and 323 BC, and the theatre of war stretched from the straits of the Hellespont all the way to the upper Indus. On the Macedonian side stood the state machine rebuilt by Philip II: the king Alexander III built his army on the core of the Companion cavalry, the phalanx infantry carrying the sarissa, the archers and the light skirmishers, supported by the Thessalian horse, the Agrianian javelinmen, the Cretan archers and the Thracian peltasts, and by a corps of siege engineers led by Athenian engineers such as Epimachus; the levy of men was apportioned among the satrapies, the allied states and the cities by population, and the army nominally marched as the commander of the Hellenic League, but the command and the supply lay entirely in the king's hands. On the Persian side were the central army of the Achaemenid monarchy and the contingents of the individual satrapies: King Darius III brought with him the royal guard, the ten thousand picked troops known as the Immortals, the shield-bearers with their wicker shields, war elephants and several hundred chariots to form the front of his line, while the satraps of the provinces, such as Artabazus the son of Pharnabazus, Arsites and Spitakes, brought the forces of their own districts, and about thirty thousand Greek mercenaries were commanded by Memnon, the empire's most formidable foreign unit. Persia still had the royal road with its posting stations across the whole realm, a vast fiscal system, and a navy built from Phoenician, Cypriot, Egyptian and Greek ships; but the fleet was divided among several admirals and was hard to coordinate strategically. In the eastern theatre, Indian kings and the peoples of northern India stood on the Persian side, while in the last years the Thracians, Macedonians and the mercenary troops of the Greek cities turned to Alexander again and again.
people: 亞歷山大三世是本役的靈魂：父王腓力二世於前三三六年遇刺時他年僅二十歲，前三三五年先以克雷德姆一役證明改革後的方陣能破敵心，再平定伊利利亞與色雷斯，前三三四年春自埃皮魯斯出發。他在十三歲時由亞里士多德在米埃茲教導三年，這段時光後來成為西方「君主修身」的著名典故，而亞歷山大自己則把阿基里斯與薛西斯一世的戰績當作行動的標尺。身邊最貼近的是終身不渝的伙伴赫費斯提翁，他以副手身分主管營務、後勤與財政，前三二四年蘇薩的集體婚禮中娶了國王的妻子斯塔泰拉；元帥帕爾梅尼翁經驗最老，卻在革拉尼庫斯與伊索斯屢次主張持重，父子之間由此積下裂痕，終至前三三〇年菲洛塔斯被處死、帕爾梅尼翁在返程途中被殺。克拉泰魯斯、佩爾狄卡斯、菲洛塔斯、佩通、阿明塔斯（後來率軍東進並兼管造幣）都是分路主將，托勒密與塞琉古則在少年時便隨軍，後來各自建國。波斯方面，國王達里烏斯三世被迫在兩條戰線應戰，一再聽從希臘人門農的戰略建議——火燒波斯地面、斷絕水源——卻因諸總督的牴牾與宮廷的猜忌而無法落實，門農本人於前三三三年病逝，戰略天才先於戰爭結束。巴克特里亞總督貝蘇斯於前三三〇年殺死達里烏斯三世並自立，前三二九年亞歷山大追入中亞時將其俘殺；前三二六年進軍印度，亞歷山大與旁遮普之王波魯斯在希達斯佩斯河會戰後互相禮遇；同年行軍至希帕西斯河，軍中嘩變要求還鄉，科厄努斯代表士兵陳情，亞歷山大最後允許他們返家。前三二三年他死於巴比倫，留下未立嗣的帝國與彼此猜忌的將領。
peopleEn: Alexander III was the soul of the campaign: when his father Philip II was assassinated in 336 BC he was only twenty, and in 335 BC he first proved at the battle of Kleidion that the reformed phalanx could break an enemy centre, then pacified the Illyrians and the Thracians, and in the spring of 334 BC he set out from Epirus. At thirteen he had been taught by Aristotle for three years at Mieza, a period that later became the famous Western text on the education of a ruler, while Alexander himself took the deeds of Achilles and of Xerxes as the measure of his own actions. Closest to him was Hephaestion, his lifelong companion, who as second-in-command ran the camp, the logistics and the finances and who in 324 BC married the king's wife Stateira in the mass wedding at Susa; the old marshal Parmenion had the longest experience but pressed for caution at the Granicus and at Issus, and the strain between father and son over this grew until in 330 BC Philotas was executed and Parmenion was killed on the march home. Craterus, Perdiccas, Philotas, Peithon and Amyntas, who later led the eastern column and also ran the mint, were the commanders of the separate columns, and Ptolemy and Seleucus were with the army as boys and would each found a kingdom of their own. On the Persian side, King Darius III was forced to fight on two fronts and repeatedly took the counsel of the Greek Memnon, who urged burning the Persian countryside and cutting the water supply, but the plan foundered on the quarrels of the satraps and on the suspicions of the court; Memnon himself died of illness in 333 BC, and the strategic talent expired before the war did. Bessus, satrap of Bactria, killed Darius III in 330 BC and assumed the royal title, and Alexander caught and killed him when he pushed into Central Asia in 329 BC. In 326 BC, in India, Alexander and Porus, king of the Punjab, met at the Hydaspes and treated each other with courtesy after the battle. In the same year, when the march reached the Hyphasis, the army mutinied and demanded to go home; Coenus spoke for the soldiers, and Alexander finally allowed them to return. In 323 BC he died at Babylon, leaving an empire without an heir and a group of generals who distrusted one another.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛出自新亞述帝國的軍械序列，年代在公元前九○○年前後，比本役早了五百六十餘年；亞述王國在前六〇九年尼尼微陷落時已滅亡，戰場上不可能出現亞述矛兵，它只能作為同源技術的祖型來看：短柄、修長的刃部與鐵製矛頭，正是「長杆加套筒鐵頭」這個結構的早期形態，而這個結構正是薩里沙長矛的直系祖先。亞述人把長矛與弓、鐵器綁在一起使用，靠著這三樣東西把兩河流域的城一個接一個打下來，矛兵與攻城錘、築城器材同時推進，這種「長矛加工程兵」的組合在兩千六百年後以希臘化軍隊的樣貌重現。真正出現在本役戰場上的長兵器有兩種：馬其頓方陣的薩里沙，長約五米半到六米餘，矛頭配鐵或青銅，後排士兵把矛斜舉過前排肩頭形成遮蔽，縱深通常十六排；波斯與其盟軍的矛較短而寬，鐵矛頭多作柳葉形，與柳條大盾和魚鱗甲配套。遠程武器方面，馬其頓方陣的弓箭手用希臘式複合弓，色雷斯輕盾兵用羅姆法西亞投槍，阿格里亞尼亞標槍手用標槍，克里特弓手用克里特弓；波斯以弓為主，騎兵用短矛與馬刀，御林與長生軍配盾，營地裡大量使用旗幟、帳幕與鼓。攻城與運輸方面，馬其頓人有扭力式攻城機、攻城塔、撞錘與築堤接城的工程，海上把多艘戰船綑在一起架起可以浮動的攻城塔；波斯方的攻城器械不如希臘工程師精細，靠城牆、高塔與長期圍困支撐。馬其頓遠征時帶著數千輛牛馬車隊、遊營帳幕與大批工匠上路，波斯則有御道驛站、象隊、戰車與大批糧車。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card comes from the arsenal of the Neo-Assyrian state, dating from about 900 BC and therefore more than five hundred and sixty years older than this campaign; the Assyrian kingdom had been destroyed when Nineveh fell in 609 BC, so no Assyrian spearmen can have stood on the field, and the weapon can only be read as the ancestor of a related craft: a short grip, a long blade and an iron head, that is, an early form of the structure of a long shaft carrying a socketed iron head, and that structure is the direct ancestor of the sarissa. The Assyrians bound the spear together with the bow and with iron, and it was with these three that they took the cities of Mesopotamia one after another, spearmen and battering rams and siege engineering advancing together; this combination of spear and engineer reappeared some two thousand six hundred years later in the dress of the Hellenistic armies. Two kinds of long weapon actually appeared on the battlefields of this war. The sarissa of the Macedonian phalanx ran from about five and a half metres to a little over six, with a head of iron or bronze, and the men in the rear ranks held their spears obliquely over the shoulders of those in front so as to make a screen, the depth of formation being normally sixteen ranks. The spears of the Persians and their allies were shorter and broader, their iron heads often of the leaf shape, and were matched with the wicker shield and the scale corselet. For missile weapons, the archers of the phalanx used the Greek composite bow, the Thracian peltasts the rhomphaia, the Agrianians the javelin, and the Cretan archers the Cretan bow; Persia relied on the bow, its cavalry used the short spear and the akinakes, the guard and the Immortals carried shields, and the camps used banners, tents and drums in quantity. On the engineering and transport side, the Macedonians had torsion engines, siege towers, battering rams and the works that joined a mole to the shore, and at sea they lashed several warships together to carry a tower that floated; the Persian siege works were less refined than those of the Greek engineers and rested on walls, towers and protracted blockade. The Macedonians marched with thousands of ox and mule carts, with tented camps and with a large body of craftsmen, while Persia had the royal road with its posting stations, elephants, chariots and a great many grain waggons.
tactics: 馬其頓的打法可以分成三層。第一層是方陣本身：十六排縱深的密集隊形，前三排持矛進刺，後排把矛斜舉過前排肩頭，把前線包成一面移動的刺牆，縱深換來的不是鋒利而是耐打；弓箭手與標槍手走在方陣之前與兩翼，用投射武器先削弱敵陣，方陣再以楔形緩慢推壓，專打敵陣最薄弱的環節。伊索斯與高加米拉兩役，亞歷山大把這個方陣擺成斜陣：右翼故意後撤、收成階梯狀，拖延波斯騎兵迂迴的時間，同時以阿格里亞尼亞標槍手與弓箭手壓住左翼，用帖薩利亞騎兵與伴騎集中打擊波斯陣線較弱的一側，衝鋒得手後不再擴大，而是以少量精銳回旋追擊，把波斯的騎兵戰意整個拖垮。第二層是進攻與攻城的銜接：亞歷山大始終把工程當作戰鬥的一部分——泰爾的堤道把海島變成半島，攻城塔沿堤道推進，底下挖地道，戰船在夜裡靠岸掩護登陸；波斯則把圍城拖成消耗戰，靠高牆、火攻與出擊的艦船擾亂堤道。第三層是後勤與戰略縱深：亞歷山大在印度河上游沒有直取印度腹地，而是先在希達斯佩斯河以舟橋渡河、擊敗波魯斯，再在希帕西斯河停下整軍；格德羅斯沙漠的一段折返則暴露遠征軍最脆弱的一面——離開御道與村鎮之後，殿後部隊在缺水與酷熱中大量耗盡。
tacticsEn: The Macedonian method can be divided into three layers. The first is the phalanx itself: a close formation sixteen ranks deep, the first three ranks thrusting with the spear while the ranks behind hold their spears obliquely over the shoulders of those in front, wrapping the front into a moving wall of points, so that depth buys endurance rather than sharpness; archers and javelinmen marched in front of the formation and on its flanks, weakening the enemy line with missiles, and the phalanx then pressed forward slowly in a wedge, striking where the enemy line was thinnest. At Issus and at Gaugamela Alexander drew this phalanx in oblique order: the right wing deliberately fell back and was drawn up in steps, so as to gain time against the Persian attempt to turn the flank, while the Agrianian javelinmen and the archers held the left, and the Thessalian horse and the Companions were concentrated against the weaker side of the Persian line; once the charge went in, it was not widened but turned and carried round in pursuit, and the fighting spirit of the Persian horse was drained away with it. The second layer is the joining of assault to siege: Alexander always treated engineering as part of the battle — the mole at Tyre turned an island into a peninsula, the siege tower advanced along the mole, sappers worked below it, and warships came in at night to cover the landing; the Persians turned every siege into a war of attrition, holding their walls, using fire, and sending their own ships out to disturb the works. The third layer is supply and strategic depth: in the upper reaches of the Indus Alexander did not strike into the heart of India at once; he bridged the Hydaspes, defeated Porus, and then halted at the Hyphasis to reorganise; and the turn back through the desert of Gedrosia showed the most fragile side of the expedition — once the royal road and the villages were left behind, the rearguard was consumed by thirst and heat.
data: 可引的數字大致如下。兵員方面，前三三四年春渡海時亞歷山大率步兵約三萬七千、騎兵約五千，合計約四萬二千人，伴騎是騎兵的骨幹；古代作者形容這支部隊的攜帶量以「每人一份穀物」為準，說的是它的編制規模。革拉尼庫斯之役，亞歷山大一方步兵約兩萬、騎兵約六千；伊索斯之役，阿利安記達里烏斯的騎兵約二萬，希臘僱傭兵步兵約三萬，戰後多數渡海散去；高加米拉之役，阿利安記波斯軍二十萬、狄奧多羅斯記一百萬，後世學者多以為前者仍嫌誇大、一百萬顯然不可信，而亞歷山大一方步兵約三萬、騎兵約五千。傷亡方面，阿利安記革拉尼庫斯之役亞歷山大一方陣亡三十四人，伊索斯之役馬其頓軍亡約二百五十名步兵、五十名騎兵，高加米拉之役的損失為數百人。攻城方面，泰爾圍城歷時約七個月，亞歷山大在堤道上架起攻城塔，據阿利安記載，埃庇馬庫斯所造的機械能把一塊重達三百六十塔倫特、橫周一百零七英尺的石頭擲向城牆。印度戰線上，波魯斯一方的戰象約二百頭，騎兵約三千，步兵與弓兵數萬，戰車數百。行程方面，全役自赫勒斯滂到印度河再到格德羅斯沙漠，後世常估總行軍里程約三萬公里，而穿越沙漠的三個月裏殿後部隊折損慘重。最後，前三二三年六月亞歷山大在巴比倫病逝，年三十二歲，帝國隨即被瓜分，前三〇一年三方劃界之勢成形。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. On strength, when he crossed the straits in the spring of 334 BC Alexander had about thirty-seven thousand foot and five thousand horse, some forty-two thousand men in all, with the Companions as the backbone of the cavalry; the remark of the ancient writers that the army's rations were reckoned at one portion of grain per man describes the scale of the formation. At the Granicus Alexander had about twenty thousand foot and six thousand horse; at Issus Arrian records about twenty thousand Persian cavalry and thirty thousand Greek mercenary foot, most of whom scattered to the sea after the battle; at Gaugamela Arrian gives the Persian army as two hundred thousand and Diodorus as one million, modern scholars holding that the former is still exaggerated and the latter plainly incredible, while Alexander had about thirty thousand foot and five thousand horse. On losses, Arrian records thirty-four men of Alexander's side killed at the Granicus, about two hundred and fifty foot and fifty horse of the Macedonian army killed at Issus, and several hundred at Gaugamela. On siegecraft, the siege of Tyre lasted about seven months, Alexander built his tower on the mole, and Arrian records that the engine made by Epimachus threw a stone of three hundred and sixty talents, with a girth of a hundred and seven feet, against the wall. On the Indian front, Porus had about two hundred war elephants, about three thousand cavalry, tens of thousands of foot and archers and several hundred chariots. On distance, the campaign ran from the Hellespont to the Indus and then into the desert of Gedrosia, and the total marching distance is commonly put at about thirty thousand kilometres, with the rearguard badly worn down during the three months across the desert. Finally, in June 323 BC Alexander died of illness at Babylon at the age of thirty-two, the empire was immediately divided, and by 301 BC the settlement of the three powers had taken shape.
cause: 這場戰爭的第一層起因是希臘與波斯的百年舊怨：前四九〇年與前四八〇年波斯兩度入侵希臘，焚雅典、劫掠愛琴海島嶼，希臘城邦視之為民族血仇；前三三四年亞歷山大以希臘同盟盟主的名義宣布出師，公開理由是解放亞洲行省、懲罰波斯人焚毀希臘神廟。第二層是腓力二世的帝國政策：他二十年來用金錢、賄賂與婚姻修補希臘城邦，毀底比、留狄奧尼西俄斯在安比索斯，並把要求波斯支付欠款與贖金的最後通牒擺上桌；國王達里烏斯三世即位後既不談判也不付款，反而在希臘散布「亞歷山大是私生子」的說法，並要求各城邦交出亞歷山大——這恰恰給了馬其頓開戰的藉口。第三層是馬其頓軍力已完成蛻變：腓力二世把農兵改造成持薩里沙、縱深十六排的方陣，用小圓盾換掉大盾，前三三五年克雷德姆一役正是這套裝備第一次在實戰中把敵陣的心口壓穿，亞歷山大也在傷亡與追擊中學會用同一套方陣對付色雷斯人與伊利利亞人。第四層是個人層面的動機：亞歷山大自幼被當作阿基里斯的再世養育，身邊同伴的壓力、家族的宿怨與希臘式的榮譽觀，把「不戰而屈人之兵」的可能性完全排除。最後還有戰略上的必然：波斯幅員太大、邊界太長，一旦失去主動便只能靠總督區的守軍勉力支撐，而亞歷山大的目標從頭到尾不是某一座城，而是達里烏斯本人與帝國的中央權力。
causeEn: The first layer of cause is the old hundred-year quarrel between Greece and Persia: in 490 and 480 BC Persia invaded Greece twice, burned Athens and plundered the islands of the Aegean, and the Greek cities held it to be a national blood feud; in 334 BC Alexander declared the campaign in his capacity as commander of the Hellenic League, giving as his public reason the liberation of the Asian satrapies and the punishment of the Persians for the burning of the Greek temples. The second layer is the imperial policy of Philip II: for twenty years he had used money, bribery and marriage to hold the Greek cities together, had destroyed Thebes, had left Dion at Amphipolis, and had put before Persia a final demand for arrears and indemnity; when King Darius III took the throne he neither negotiated nor paid, and instead spread the story in Greece that Alexander was a bastard, and called on the cities to hand Alexander over — which gave Macedon precisely the pretext for war. The third layer is that the Macedonian army had completed its transformation: Philip had turned his farmers into a phalanx of sarissa-bearing men sixteen ranks deep, exchanging the great shield for the small round one, and the battle of Kleidion in 335 BC was the first time in earnest that this equipment was seen to break through the heart of an enemy line; Alexander himself learned on that march to use the same phalanx against the Thracians and the Illyrians. The fourth layer is personal: Alexander had been raised from childhood as the reincarnation of Achilles, and the pressure of his companions, the enmity of the house and the Greek sense of honour together excluded any possibility of winning without a war. There is finally a tactical inevitability: Persia was too vast and its frontiers too long, and once it lost the initiative it could do nothing but rely on the garrisons of the satrapies, whereas Alexander's object was never any single city but Darius himself and the central power of the empire.
impact: 戰爭最直接的一項後果，是阿契美尼德波斯帝國五百年統治的終結：前三三〇年達里烏斯三世被自己的總督貝蘇斯殺死，波斯王室、中央軍與總督體系隨之瓦解，而希臘化各國接手的並非空殼，而是一整套可以運作的帝國機器——御道驛站、稅制、灌溉工程、多語言的官僚與已經希臘化的城市。第二，亞歷山大留下的帝國因為無子而立刻被瓜分：前三二三年的巴比倫分封會議上，繼承者被降格為傀儡，腓力三世與亞歷山大四世只掛名而已，前三〇一年三國劃界成為定局，托勒密王朝治埃及、塞琉古王朝治亞洲、安提柯王朝治馬其頓，希臘化時代的版圖就這樣在十年內成形。第三，這十年把希臘語、希臘幣制與希臘作風推到了中亞與印度河流域：費羅沙的亞歷山大城、今巴基斯坦的開伯爾與犍陀羅，粟特與巴克特里亞的希臘化城邦，以及後來的印希臘王國與貴霜帝國，都是這場戰爭的直接產物；佛教的早期經典留有「耶雲那」王入侵印度的記錄，阿育王的詔令中則提到名叫阿彌利卡與哈利卡的耶雲那王，希臘世界與南亞世界從此互相看見。第四，軍事技術上，這場戰爭把薩里沙方陣、騎兵投射、攻城工程與超遠距離後勤推到了極限，希臘化諸王與後來的羅馬都把方陣與投射武器當作基本功；波利比奧斯甚至把羅馬軍制的改變歸因於與馬其頓方陣交手的經驗。代價與陰影同樣清楚：前三三〇年波斯波利斯王宮被焚，亞歷山大手下在推薩出殺害同袍克拉泰魯斯，前三二三年帝國在他死後立刻陷入繼承者戰爭，亞歷山大的「暴君」形象在古代史家筆下與「救主」形象並存。
impactEn: The most direct consequence of the war was the end of five hundred years of Achaemenid rule: Darius III was killed in 330 BC by his own satrap Bessus, and the royal house, the central army and the system of satrapies fell apart with him, so that the Hellenistic states inherited not an empty shell but a working imperial machine — the royal road and its posting stations, the fiscal system, the irrigation works, the polyglot bureaucracy and the cities already Hellenised. Second, the empire Alexander left behind, having no heir, was divided at once: at the settlement of Babylon in 323 BC the successors were reduced to puppets, Philip III and Alexander IV ruling only in name, and by 301 BC the three-way partition was settled, with the Ptolemies over Egypt, the Seleucids over Asia and the Antigonids over Macedon, and the map of the Hellenistic age took shape within a decade. Third, the ten years carried the Greek language, Greek coinage and Greek manners into Central Asia and the Indus valley: Alexandria in Arachosia, the Hellenised cities of Sogdiana and Bactria, and later the Indo-Greek kingdom and the Kushan empire were direct products of this war; the early Buddhist canon preserves a record of the invasion of India by a king of the Yavana, and the edicts of Ashoka name Yavana kings called Amilaka and Hamilaka, so that the Greek world and the world of southern Asia saw one another from then on. Fourth, in military terms the war pushed the sarissa phalanx, mounted missile tactics, siege engineering and logistics over very long distances to their limits, and the Hellenistic kings and Rome after them all made the phalanx and the missile arms their basic stock; Polybius even attributed the reform of the Roman army to the experience of fighting Macedonian phalanxes. The cost and the shadow were equally plain: the palace of Persepolis was burned in 330 BC, Alexander's own men killed the companion Craterus at Potaia, and in 323 BC the empire fell immediately into a war of the successors, so that in the ancient historians the tyrant and the saviour sit side by side in the figure of Alexander.
result: 就軍事過程而言，亞歷山大一方是全勝的一方：他從未輸過一場會戰，渡海之後奪取米利都、以弗所、撒爾迪、泰爾、埃及、高加米拉、波斯波利斯、蘇薩與巴克特里亞，把阿契美尼德的領土從愛琴海一路推到印度河，達里烏斯三世的營帳、行軍縱隊與御用車隊都在高加米拉落入他手裡；國王的妻子斯塔泰拉與母親西斯甘比斯被俘後得到有禮的對待，卻終究沒有換來波斯方面的投降。戰爭的終點卻是一個沒有繼承人的帝國：前三二三年六月，亞歷山大在巴比倫病逝，時年三十二歲，臨終前在御前把戒指交給繼承者而非自己指定的接班人，留下一句「交給最優秀者」的話，這句話的史實性素有爭議，歷代史家卻都如此記載。帝國在幾個月內被將領瓜分，前三二三年巴比倫會議上留下的是共同統治的傀儡君主，前三〇一年伊普蘇斯一役後三方正式劃界。此後兩百年間，這場戰爭的果實以另一種形式存在：塞琉古與托勒密兩家為繼承亞歷山大的帝國打了半個多世紀，最後托勒密王朝佔埃及，塞琉古帝國佔亞洲與美索不達米亞，安提柯王朝治馬其頓，帕提亞人於前二四七年趁塞琉古衰微取兩河與波斯，羅馬則在前二世紀接過整個希臘化世界。單看一場戰爭，這是一場以全勝告終卻在終點失去一切的戰役；拉開看，它把亞歷山大的征服轉成了一段長達三個半世紀的希臘化時代，古代東地中海與伊朗之間的交流、錢幣、藝術與宗教，都建立在這十年留下的版圖之上。
resultEn: In the military process itself Alexander's side won every battle: he never lost an action, and after the crossing he took Miletus, Ephesus, Sardis, Tyre, Egypt, Gaugamela, Persepolis, Susa and Bactria, pushing the Achaemenid territory from the Aegean all the way to the Indus, and the tent, the marching column and the baggage train of Darius III all fell into his hands at Gaugamela; Stateira, the king's wife, and his mother Sisygambis were captured and treated with courtesy, yet this never bought surrender on the Persian side. The end of the war, however, was an empire without an heir: in June 323 BC Alexander died of illness at Babylon at the age of thirty-two, and before he died he passed his ring in the presence of the court rather than to a successor he had named, leaving the words 'to the best of them', whose historicity has long been debated, though every later historian records them that way. Within a few months the empire was divided among the generals; what the assembly at Babylon in 323 BC left was a puppet monarch ruling in common, and after the battle of Ipsus in 301 BC the three powers were formally delimited. For the two centuries that followed, the fruits of this war existed in another form: the Seleucids and the Ptolemies fought for half a century over the inheritance of Alexander's empire, and in the end the Ptolemies held Egypt, the Seleucid empire held Asia and Mesopotamia, the Antigonids held Macedon, the Parthians took the Two Rivers and Persia from a declining Seleucid empire in 247 BC, and Rome took over the whole Hellenistic world in the second century BC. Taken as a single war, this was a campaign that ended in complete victory and lost everything at the finish; taken at a distance, it turned Alexander's conquest into a Hellenistic age lasting three and a half centuries, and the exchanges of coin, art and religion between the eastern Mediterranean and Iran all rest on the map that these ten years left behind.
